name: batch2-daemon-plugin
description: Batch 2 QA: daemon modular architecture (DI, command bus, lifecycle, state) + plugin sdk/support three-layer framework + Commander.js CLI.

steps.description: Service container token registration, resolution, conflict, and optional dependency.
steps.expect: All DI operations follow typed token contract with stable error behavior.

steps.description: Command registration, dispatch, conflict detection, and listing.
flow: register + dispatch → handler called with args
steps.expect: Command bus correctly routes and rejects with typed errors.

steps.description: Daemon state transitions: idle → starting → active → stopping → stopped, plus failed and rolled_back.
steps.expect: State store accurately tracks daemon lifecycle with observable phase mapping.

steps.description: DaemonHost preserves all existing public API after modularization.
flow: start / stop / status / listPlugins / showPlugin / listCommands
listMountDescriptors / listVfs / readVfs / statVfs / watchVfs / streamVfs
Plugin setup and dispose order preserved
steps.expect: All 4 existing daemon tests pass unchanged. New modules don't break backward compat.

steps.description: CLI now routes through Commander.js with structured command groups.
flow: daemon start / daemon stop via Commander
plugin list / plugin show / command list
vfs list / vfs read / vfs stat / vfs watch / vfs stream
steps.expect: All existing CLI tests pass. Commander.js routing is transparent to consumers.

steps.description: Plugin SDK is now split into manifest/contribution/context/types modules.
steps.expect: SDK layer is minimal and self-contained. No dependency on plugin-support.

steps.description: New plugin-support package: registry, dependency graph, conflict detection, lifecycle.
flow: PluginLifecycleManager: setup, dispose in reverse order
steps.expect: Support layer provides all platform runtime utilities without SDK dependency.

steps.description: Three-layer import boundary: sdk does not import support; support imports sdk + shared; plugins import sdk + support.
steps.expect: Import boundaries are clean. No reverse dependencies.
